models_evaluated: transfer learning-based end-to-end neonatal pain detection neural network with manual assessment branch

links.outcome: Framework accuracy when low-confidence cases are deferred to manual assessment
links.effect: Overall framework accuracy reached 82.35% with the manual assessment branch integrated. The abstract says this integration raises recall of true pain events and reduces manual evaluation effort.
links.quote: Experimental results show our neural network sur- passes state-of-the-art algorithms by at least 25% in accuracy on the MNPAD dataset, with overall framework accuracy reaching 82.35% with integration of manual assessment branch.

screen.practice: Manual clinician review of low-confidence cases
screen.reason: Evaluates a neonatal pain detection framework that explicitly integrates and tests a safeguard/deployment practice: routing low-confidence/borderline cases to a manual assessment branch.
